scientific_integrity: The all-threshold sign theorem and constants 15 and 5/8 are analytical; numerical checks are supplementary. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only homogeneous continuous-time on/off rates and first-bond start with two absorbing thresholds.
Maximizing conditional stabilization time is not maximizing success probability or minimizing total time per success.
Asymptotic assertions require the large-threshold limit with the on-rate held fixed.
Earlier general birth-death spectral frameworks and the original nonmonotonic illustration are prior work; publication priority is not independently established.
title: A unique dissociation-rate bottleneck for successful multivalent attachment
